svg.title: Pause compute. Keep progress.
svg.desc: Ten warm restore cycles on a Ryzen 7 4800U Kubernetes node. Median pause 4.07 seconds, median resume to a healthy App 2.99 seconds, ten of ten state checks passed. Two Node containers and 256 MiB random application memory, worker limited to 3 CPU and 3 GiB RAM.

g.text: Resume the App. Not a fresh boot.
Ryzen 7 4800U · k3s · 3 CPU / 3 GiB worker · two Node containers · 256 MiB random App memory
Ten warm cycles on one environment. Includes Kubernetes transport. Measured 7 November 2026.
